{
  "findings": [
    {
      "page": 491,
      "where": "Formula (10.2.1), right-hand member",
      "scan": "\\Hom_E(Z,\\scrHom_E(X,Y))\\simeq \\scrHom_E(Z\\times X,Y)",
      "tex": "\\Hom_E(Z,\\scrHom_E(X,Y))\\simeq \\scrHom_E(Z\\times X,\nY)",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\Hom_E(Z,\\scrHom_E(X,Y))\\simeq \\Hom_E(Z\\times X,Y)",
      "note": "The printed right-hand Hom has a script H, although this member must be the set of morphisms. The TeX keeps the misprint."
    },
    {
      "page": 491,
      "where": "Proof of 10.3, introduction to the chain of isomorphisms",
      "scan": "fonctoriels en tous les arguments",
      "tex": "fonctoriels en tout les arguments",
      "kind": "word",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "en tout les arguments",
        "new": "en tous les arguments"
      },
      "note": "The print has « tous », not « tout »."
    },
    {
      "page": 492,
      "where": "10.4.1, reference following the equivalence of topoi",
      "scan": "(III 4 et IV 1)",
      "tex": "(\\hyperrefext[III][III.sec4]{4} et\n\\hyperref[IV.sec1]{1})",
      "kind": "number",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\hyperref[IV.sec1]{1}",
        "new": "IV~\\hyperref[IV.sec1]{1}"
      },
      "note": "The exposé numeral IV is omitted. This recurring reference convention is reported once; three examples are listed in the coordinator."
    },
    {
      "page": 492,
      "where": "Lemma 10.4.2, final formula",
      "scan": "\\scrHom_{E^{\\sim}_{V}}(X,Y), with V not underlined",
      "tex": "\\scrHom_{E^{\\sim}_{V}}(X,Y)",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\scrHom_{E^{\\sim}_{𝒱}}(X,Y)",
      "note": "The subscript should be the universe 𝒱 defined immediately before. Its distinguishing underline is absent here in the print; the TeX keeps the plain V."
    },
    {
      "page": 493,
      "where": "10.5.2, object Y used to define Lambda",
      "scan": "pour tout objet Y de E",
      "tex": "tout objet $Y$ de $E$",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "tout objet $Y$ de $E'$",
      "note": "Y must belong to E' for v^{\\ast}Y to be defined. The print says E, and the TeX keeps it."
    },
    {
      "page": 493,
      "where": "10.5.3, right-hand Hom in the inline trifunctional morphism",
      "scan": "\\Hom_{E'}(v_{!}(X\\times v^{\\ast}Z,Y)",
      "tex": "\\Hom_{E'}(v_{!}(X\\times v^{\\ast}Z),Y))",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\Hom_{E'}(v_{!}(X\\times v^{\\ast}Z),Y)",
      "note": "The print lacks the closing parenthesis after Z. The TeX supplies it, correcting that misprint, but also introduces the extra final parenthesis reported separately."
    },
    {
      "page": 493,
      "where": "10.5.3, end of the same inline right-hand Hom",
      "scan": "Only one closing parenthesis follows Y.",
      "tex": "\\Hom_{E'}(v_{!}(X\\times v^{\\ast}Z),Y))",
      "kind": "extra",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": {
        "old": "\\Hom_{E'}(v_{!}(X\\times v^{\\ast}Z),Y))",
        "new": "\\sisi{\\Hom_{E'}(v_{!}(X\\times v^{\\ast}Z,Y)}{\\Hom_{E'}(v_{!}(X\\times v^{\\ast}Z),Y)}"
      },
      "note": "There is an extra final parenthesis in the TeX. The replacement records the printed reading in the first argument of \\sisi and the balanced correction in the second."
    },
    {
      "page": 493,
      "where": "10.5.4, last displayed formula",
      "scan": "\\Hom_E(v^{\\ast}(Z)\\times v^{\\ast}(X),v^{\\ast}y)",
      "tex": "\\Hom_E (v^{\\ast}(Z)\\times\nv^{\\ast}(X), v^{\\ast}Y)",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "\\Hom_E(v^{\\ast}(Z)\\times v^{\\ast}(X),v^{\\ast}Y)",
      "note": "The print has a lowercase y in the last argument, although the object introduced is Y. The TeX silently corrects it."
    },
    {
      "page": 495,
      "where": "Opening formula; boundary between pages 494 and 495",
      "scan": "Page 495 begins with the complete chain \\scrHom(\\amalg_I v^{\\ast}(e'),v^{\\ast}Y)\\simeq\\Pi_i\\scrHom(v^{\\ast}(e'),v^{\\ast}Y)\\simeq\\Pi_I v^{\\ast}Y.",
      "tex": "v^{\\ast}Y$.\\pageoriginale Le morphisme fonctoriel $\\Phi_v$ induit",
      "kind": "marker",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "note": "Page 494 actually ends after « \\Pi_I Y$ et ». The opening Hom chain of page 495 has its first two TeX lines assigned to page 494, beyond the overlap allowed by the comments. The cut must be corrected; no text should be inserted or duplicated."
    },
    {
      "page": 495,
      "where": "Proof of 10.8, description of the final object e_Z",
      "scan": "(i.e. l'objet id_Z : Z → Z) ).",
      "tex": "(\\ie l'objet\n$\\id_Z:Z\\rightarrow Z$)).",
      "kind": "misprint_in_print",
      "confidence": "high",
      "fix": null,
      "corrected": "(\\ie l'objet $\\id_Z:Z\\rightarrow Z$).",
      "note": "The print has an unmatched second closing parenthesis. The TeX keeps it."
    }
  ],
  "coordinator": "491: 1/1; 492: 1/1; 493: 1/3; 494: 0/0; 495: 1/1 (normal/misprint).\n494/495: recut after « \\Pi_I Y$ et »; the complete following \\scrHom chain opens page 495.\nReference convention, reported once: unmarked omission of IV at p.492, 10.4.1 (III 4 et IV 1); p.494, 10.6.1 (IV 1.8); p.495, 10.7 (IV 5.2). Besides the supplied p.492 fix, prefix \\hyperref[IV.rem1.8]{1.8} and \\hyperref[IV.subsec5.2]{5.2} with IV~."
}
